name: Cat Island
text: Cat Island is located in the Bahamas, and is one of its districts. Cat Island also has the nation's highest point, Mount Alvernia (formerly known as Como Hill). It rises to 63 metres (207 ft) and is topped by a monastery called The Hermitage.

depictions.name: Cat Island
depictions.text: Cat Island, Bahamas Cat Island is a thin islet located in the central Bahamas. During the early 18th century, the island was home to a sizable Beckford Estate-owned sugar plantation, which the pirate Edward Kenway later raided.
